metadata.description: Indian entrance examinations and related admission tests across medical, engineering, management, law, science, design, agriculture, nursing and other educational fields. Availability and participation vary by year and institution.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify time-sensitive details on the linked official source before relying on them.
notes: Exam dates, eligibility, syllabus, fees, application windows and participating institutions must be refreshed from the official portal for each cycle.
A listed examination does not guarantee that every institution or programme accepts its score.
Some institutions use separate admission tests, while others use national or state-level examinations.
Professional licensing, recruitment and eligibility examinations are not interchangeable with university entrance examinations.
Official URLs are reference starting points and must be checked for current-cycle relevance before publication.
